opencode.name: OpenCode
opencode.description: The OpenCode coding agent harness driving a single model. Each agent using this harness pairs OpenCode with one model endpoint.

opencode-hybrid.name: OpenCode (Hybrid)
opencode-hybrid.description: A hybrid OpenCode configuration that pairs two models: one for planning/orchestration and one for execution.

claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.description: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI running headless (claude -p) against a single model over the Anthropic Messages API. Web tools are offered but always refused; the sandbox has no network egress.

codex.name: Codex
codex.description: OpenAI's Codex CLI running headless (codex exec) against a single model. Its native web search is disabled; the sandbox has no network egress.
